Geographies Served Programs HOPE Programme HOPE, led by founders Chhitra Subramaniam and Surya Balakrishnan, collaborates with Mesh Foundation to tirelessly provide medical support, including medicines, oxygen, hospitalization, and food, since the onset of the Covid pandemic in 2020. It has been running a Daily Nutrition programme for the past 6 months, offering essential supplementary nutrition such as eggs, milk, and bananas to 1500 children in 5 vulnerable communities in Mumbai. The programme, initiated during the 2nd wave to boost children's immunity, now aims to address chronic hunger and malnourishment, ensuring sustained support for at least another 6 months. Additionally, they distribute grocery kits to individuals in need across Mumbai and other cities. Covid Relief Programme Mesh Foundation, in collaboration with Live to Give, has been actively supporting individuals in need during these challenging times. It has been engaged in providing essential supplies such as medicines, oxygen, hospitalization, and food since the onset of the Covid pandemic in 2020. The dedicated team focused on assisting COVID-19 frontline workers, distributing rations to underprivileged communities, and offering medical support to both Covid and non-Covid patients. Milestones & Track Record Since its founding in 2015, Mesh Foundation has provided financial assistance to over 500 cancer patients and offered counseling services to over 1000 patients and family members. --> --> Leadership Team Deepak Shah Team Member Hitesh Shah Team Member Sanjay Dhruva Team Member Suruchi Choksi Team Member Demographics & Structure Organisation Strength None M&E Internal, External Assessors No --> Political & Religious Declarations On Affiliation if any No On Deployment Bias if any No --> Registration Details PAN Card AACTM2284J Registration Number E-25464/Mumbai CSR Form 1 CSR00005794 80G AACTM2284JF20093 12A AACTM2284JE20214 FCRA Not Available About Headquarters Mumbai, Maharashtra Since 2009 Demographies Served Youth Women Children Men --> Impact Mesh Foundation has helped hundreds of cancer patients access treatment and support services they otherwise could not afford. Vision and Mission The vision of Mesh Foundation is to ensure no cancer patient is denied treatment due to financial constraints. Their mission is to provide holistic support to cancer patients and their families.
